newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha easy, buyers stay scarce.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha easy, buyers stay scarce.

text.p: NWE spot and paper naphtha prices remained easy in early trade on Thursday with discussion very thin as buyers stayed scarce, traders said.

Sellers of physical cargoes continued to reduce offers amid poor demand and good supply, while paper markets extended Wednesday's losses as gasoline markets remained under pressure with the key U.S. markets seen well supplied.
Ample refinery supply in ARA pegged barge prices back to around $175-$176. Traders said there was little demand.
Cargo sellers eased offers a couple of dollars but a dearth of buying interest left the market notional.

After loosing ground on Wednesday in sympathy with weaker gasoline markets, swaps prices continued to slide shedding a further $2 in early business with May contracts valued around $180 a tonne cif NWE.
